headline: Asda to install up to 700 InPost parcel lockers across UK stores
summary: One of InPost's largest UK retail rollouts yet, spanning superstores, supermarkets and Express formats — another sign grocers are packing stores with non-grocery services beyond the aisle.

headline: MilkPEP launches Milkscape, a one-stop dairy shopper-intelligence hub
summary: A new dairy checkoff platform consolidates Circana, Numerator and Mintel data into one resource — worth watching as retail conversations lean more on this kind of shared category data.

headline: Dairy case baskets ring up nearly 2x non-dairy baskets, new Circana data shows
summary: Shoppers who buy dairy milk spend $88.79 per trip vs. $46.23 without it, and buying multiple dairy formats (value-added, traditional) drives ~30% more volume — a strong case for cross-merchandising cheese alongside other dairy.

headline: Kroger cuts its 2026 same-store sales outlook
summary: Kroger trimmed full-year identical-store sales guidance to 0.2%-0.8% from 1%-2% — a signal that grocery volume pressure is broadening beyond perishables into overall basket growth.

headline: East Hill Creamery named Grand Champion at NY State Dairy Products Competition
summary: 187 entries across 26 categories this year — a good regional credibility signal and sourcing lead for buyers building out an artisanal/award-winning cheese set.

headline: Irish buffalo cheese maker recalls mozzarella and bocconcini over Listeria
summary: Macroom Buffalo Cheese pulled all 125g mozzarella and 160g bocconcini packs with a use-by date of Sept. 7 — worth checking import/distribution lists for exposure.

headline: Save Mart expands Instacart curbside pickup across all NorCal banners
summary: Curbside is now live at Save Mart, Lucky and FoodMaxx stores — another sign grocers are leaning on third-party delivery infrastructure for perishables like cheese.

headline: CME cash cheese holds mostly steady as blocks edge down to $1.4225/lb
summary: Barrels flat at $1.4525/lb, blocks off a cent — a near-term signal for cost planning on block cheddar.

headline: Grocery unit sales slump in August as cyclospora scare hits produce
summary: Produce unit sales fell 6.7% after a cyclospora outbreak spooked shoppers — a reminder that food-safety scares can drag down adjacent perishable categories like cheese and deli.

headline: Global Dairy Trade index slips 1.1% as Cheddar prices jump 16.5%
summary: Cheddar led gains in the mid-September GDT auction while mozzarella and butter softened — worth watching for input costs on cheddar-heavy lines.

headline: Canada adds cheese to retaliatory tariffs on US goods
summary: Cross-border dairy trade fight escalates — a reason to flag exposure for any US-origin SKUs moving into Canadian accounts.
